stances.summary: Disputes fraud claims by analyzing ballot timing and voter registration data
stances.quote: For those claiming fraud because Spencer Pratt did worse as the later ballots were counted, this chart is of the registered Dem share advantage over registered GOPs by each day of ballot returns.

stances.summary: Democratic support improving across demographic groups since Trump took office
stances.quote: Good news for Dems - the Dem margin has been steadily improving among all groups since Trump took office. And this is the first time, outside of pre-election bumps, that the Dem downward turn among Black voters has reversed.  And Dems have even improved substantially with whites.

stances.summary: Democratic special election victory drove 22-point swing in GOP district
stances.quote: This election happened in August of last year, in a district that Trump carried by 11 pts in 2024. The Dem candidate, Catelin Drey, won by an almost identical margin, representing an almost 22 pt swing towards Dems, resulting in GOPs losing their supermajority in the IA Senate.

stances.summary: GOP spent over twice as much as Democrats on Texas primary campaigns
stances.quote: Let's keep in mind, the GOP reportedly spent upwards of $80 million on their primaries in Texas, well more than double the amount spent by Dems.

stances.summary: Democratic primary turnout exceeded Republican in GOP-gerrymandered districts
stances.quote: Here are 4 districts the TX GOP gerrymandered to gain seats in November, with the Dem and GOP primary vote. Dems outvoted GOPs in every one of them.

stances.summary: Democratic Hispanic voter primary turnout significantly higher than 2024 general
stances.quote:
Wow, the Dem primary turnout among Hispanic voters in Texas is going to be giving the GOP sweats for the next 8 months. 

Take Zapata County - turnout in the Dem primary there yesterday was 143% the total number of votes Harris won in the 2024 general election. That's wild.

stances.summary: Urges Democrats to fight for struggling Americans to regain trust
stances.quote:
My message to Dem electeds: One of the big reasons we lost in 2024 was because people didn't see us as their champions. 

You have the chance to change that, starting now. Millions are desperately in need of your help in the face of Trump's funding freeze. Fight for them.

stances.summary: Criticizes voters for electing oldest president on inflation-worsening platform
stances.quote: We heard for most of the past 2+ years that voters were deeply concerned with inflation and the president's age.  Now we have the oldest president ever elected who ran on a platform that will almost certainly lead to inflation. Great work, all.

stances.summary: Media largely failed to warn voters about Trump deportations' inflationary impact
stances.quote: Kind of wild that, of all these stories written about how Trump's deportations will likely cause even higher prices in grocery stores, only one was published before election day. https://t.co/OTcAlYEJZ6

stances.summary: Warns that something is unhealthy occurring in democracy
stances.quote: This sort of thing doesn't happen in a healthy democracy.

stances.summary: Criticizes debate moderators for checking only small fraction of Trump's lies
stances.quote: According to CNN fact checker, Daniel Dale, Trump told at least 33 distinct lies during the debate last night. He was fact checked by the moderators on 3 lies. 91% of his lies went unchecked, but to his enablers that amounted to biased, unfair moderation.

stances.summary: Questions Nate Silver's polling analysis and dire Harris campaign predictions
stances.quote:
So over the past couple of days, Nate Silver has been tweeting multiple times a day insisting that things are looking worse and worse for the Harris campaign. 

One state he claims has moved 1.2 pts to Trump since the convention is WI. Let's take a look at the recent polls there.

stances.summary: Skeptical of Trump's claims about military authority
stances.quote: He does realize that the military existed before him and will exist after, right?

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for using tragedy to attack Democrats without retracting false claims
stances.quote: So now that the alleged killer has been named and we can say that he is not a registered Democrat, I am sure the president and everyone else who ghoulishly used this tragedy to fan flames of retribution against Democrats will retract their statements and apologize, right?

stances.summary: Calls for Trump's impeachment over refusal to uphold Constitution
stances.quote: I'm sorry, but a president who answers the question "don't you need to uphold the Constitution of the United States" with anything other than "yes" (Trump said, "I don't know) must be impeached.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of weaponizing DOJ against political opponents
stances.quote: I challenge any Trump supporter to explain how this isn’t Trump weaponizing the DoJ to go after his political opponents.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for extorting law firm; calls impeachment warranted
stances.quote: In a functional democracy, this would be enough to impeach and convict Trump. Yet, not only will that not happen, I would venture a guess that 95% of Americans will never even know that the president extorted a law firm.

stances.summary: Warns of flight safety risks from firing experienced FAA employees
stances.quote: This is terrifying. Most obviously, it seems that flying in this country will become increasingly dangerous. Beyond that, if true, the dogebros are firing experienced, difficult to replace federal employees because AI doesn't understand how the "probationary" term works.

stances.summary: Criticizes executive overreach and sycophantic behavior
stances.quote: This is North Korean levels of executive derangement and sycophancy.

stances.summary: Blames Musk influence for FAA administrator removal over safety violations
stances.quote: We currently do not have an FAA Administrator, because the previous one was forced out by the billionaire who got Trump elected and was given unchecked authority in return. He was forced out because he tried to fine the billionaire's space company for operating unsafely.

stances.summary: Critiques Trump's intervention in personnel decisions
stances.quote: I mean... had Trump not gotten Balogun reinstated, at least we would have an excuse for losing and could have spent the next 4 years blissfully overconfident.

stances.summary: Criticizes wasteful spending on reflecting pool color changes
stances.quote: Personally, I don't really care what color the reflecting pool is... the blue looks as good as the green. I do care that we spent a lot of money to make it blue, and are spending more money now that it is green. But there are also more important things to focus on.

stances.summary: Questions practicality of White House security protocols for events
stances.quote: I genuinely don't understand how this is supposed to work. It's not like the White House is a sports stadium where fans can seek cover under the stands during a thunderstorm. I assume they'd have to empty the WH grounds and then face rescreening the fans, which would take a long

stances.summary: Defends CBS for fact-checking claims about Haitian migrants' legal status
stances.quote: For the record, what CBS dared to do was to point out that the Haitian migrants who have been demonized by Trump and Vance are actually here legally. That's all.

stances.summary: Criticizes 'Twitter Files' narrative for misconstruing content moderation practices
stances.quote:
- Twitter was worried about being used to distribute hacked info without info on veracity or source, so they removed this content out of an abundance of caution. This made some people angry.

That's it so far, after something like 40 tweets.

stances.summary: Summarizes Twitter Files as showing both parties requested deletions, not scandal
stances.quote:
Here's a summary of the Taibbi thread for those who don't want to wade through it:
- Both Dems and GOPs asked twitter to delete certain tweets, and twitter sometimes obliged.

stances.summary: Criticizes media reliance on prediction markets as unreliable reporting
stances.quote: Stop reporting on prediction markets. I beg of you. They had Hong as an absolute sure thing until an hour ago. It's ill informed vibes and reporters should treat it as such.

stances.summary: Suggests media will use low-quality polls to create false Democratic crisis narrative
stances.quote:
Cue the parade of polling firms you've never heard of before to produce a flood of zero transparency surveys. 

(just kidding, they won't do that until after Labor Day, to create a narrative of the Dems blowing it)

stances.summary: Fact-checks misleading claims about pool color
stances.quote: Yes, the Democrats will tell you there's green algae. As will your eyes, because the pool you just said was painted "American flag blue" is more green than the grass that surrounds it.

stances.summary: Criticizes commentator for factual errors
stances.quote: One would think this guy would do a quick google before confidently stating that voters needed an excuse to cast a vote by mail “pretty much everywhere” before 10 years ago.

stances.summary: Questions detention of elected official in legislative chamber
stances.quote: How is an elected official being held prisoner inside a legislative chamber something we are apparently largely okay with now?

stances.summary: Criticizes FBI for distraction from core mission by 2020 voter fraud investigations
stances.quote: Good thing we have very experienced and competent leadership at the FBI and they totally have not been distracted by their snipe hunt looking for voter fraud from 2020.

stances.summary: Criticizes Mississippi governor for welfare dependency while rejecting child nutrition programs
stances.quote: Mississippi is a literal welfare state, in that it takes almost 3x the amount of federal dollars its taxpayers pay in. And Gov Reeves is fine with that, unless you want to spend that money on hungry kids, then it's a no.

stances.summary: Calls for official removal from position
stances.quote: Platner needs to go, and should have gone a long time ago.

stances.summary: Media underreported worsening inflation compared to prior year
stances.quote: What's weird about this is, a year ago all the media talked about was how awful inflation was. Here we are, a year later, and it is worse. Yet I'd bet it gets only a tiny fraction of the press attention it got last year.

stances.summary: Disputes Trump's claim that tariffs don't affect consumer prices
stances.quote: Attention Walmart shoppers: despite what you’ve been told, you’re paying the tariffs.

stances.summary: Criticizes hypocrisy of Republicans claiming free speech victimhood
stances.quote: Think of all the ink spilled over the past 8 years loudly declaring Republicans as the party of free speech because conservative speakers were subject to campus boycotts.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump administration scapegoating DEI for airline crash
stances.quote: First Trump blamed DEI for the crash. Then Duffy and Hegseth dutifully agreed, it was DEI. Now JD Vance is saying that, even if no one involved was part of a diversity program, it is still the fault of DEI, because DEI "exhausts" and strains everyone working in its midst.

stances.summary: Criticizes asymmetric media accountability for Democrats versus Republicans
stances.quote: The last few weeks it seems every Democrat has been forced to comment on Hasan Piker (a streamer, not even a member of the Dem Party). Yet I'd bet not a single Republican candidate will have to answer for Trump's racism, despite him being a leader of the party.

stances.summary: Defends rooting for Team USA despite Trump admin FIFA appeal success
stances.quote: I genuinely don't get rooting against the US tonight, because of the Trump administration's successful appeal. I don't know enough about FIFA's rules to know if this decision was defensible, but I do know that I'm not going to blame Team USA for FIFA's mistake (if they made one).

stances.summary: Criticizes excessive politicization of everyday life as exhausting
stances.quote: I've worked in politics all of my adult life. I consume a lot of political info. Yet, even I find this sort of thing where people try to make literally everything in their life political just exhausting.
